population_note_text: The read of the books itself: no voucher is examined.

figures.definition_text: Whether this read of the books includes their currency settings.

findings.title_text: The books' currency was not read: every amount is taken as Indian rupees
limits_text: This read of the books does not include their currency settings. Every ledger is taken to be kept in Indian rupees. A book kept in another currency, or a ledger kept in a foreign currency whose amounts carry no foreign-currency value, would not be detected.
Amounts that do carry a foreign-currency value are refused, so no figure mixes currencies from them.
ask_client_text: Confirm that the books are kept in Indian rupees and that no ledger is kept in a foreign currency.
